implementation.targetScope: Current glob matching semantics for VentiMath build paths and URL/header patterns; unchanged glob 13 raw and Redocly callers, with callable CommonJS and RegExp-shaped adapters for older consumers.

differences: Own bounded position-set interpreter and explicit extglob/path stacks; no upstream runtime matcher dependency.
Legacy RegExp-shaped segment and makeRe adapters support test/exec, not native source/flags serialization, replacement or RegExp reconstruction.
AST and upstream internal optimizer/cache classes are not provided; no whole-toolchain override or deployment is claimed.
Constructor options are copied. Work exhaustion throws RangeError rather than returning a guessed match. maxGlobstarRecursion is retained for source compatibility; the interpreter does not recurse.
Brace expansion inherits VPM's explicit output/work bounds and literal fallback for unsafe numeric ranges.
Compact ranges can return actual directory-entry casing through older glob callers where their expanded literal patterns return pattern casing.
